details.title: iLMeteo.it — Instance details
details.description: Selected location: {city}. Choose a custom display name (optional), which dedicated sensors to create, whether to enable weather alert notifications, optionally a Civil Protection sensor entity (caiosweet's 'DPC Alert' integration, if installed) as an additional official source, and optionally one or more notify.* targets to also push to besides the native persistent notification. Everything can be changed later from Options.

data_description.dpc_alert_entity_id: Optionally, select a `sensor.dpc_alert` entity from caiosweet's [DPC Alert](https://github.com/caiosweet/Home-Assistant-custom-components-DPC-Alert) integration, if installed, to add official Civil Protection bulletins as an alert source. Leave blank if you don't have that integration.

reconfigure_region.title: iLMeteo.it — Change location: Region
reconfigure_region.description: Select the new region. The display name will be reset to the new municipality's name; you can customize it again afterwards from Options.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to iLMeteo.it. Please try again later.
error.no_data: No weather data available for this municipality.

abort.already_configured: This municipality is already configured, or already tracked by another instance of the integration.

init.title: iLMeteo.it — Name and sensors
init.description: Change the custom display name, which dedicated sensors are enabled, whether weather alert notifications are enabled, which Civil Protection sensor entity (caiosweet's 'DPC Alert' integration, if installed) to use as an additional source, and which notify.* targets to also push to (besides the native persistent notification, always sent). Deselecting an already-enabled sensor deletes it, losing its history.

data_description.dpc_alert_entity_id: Optionally, select a `sensor.dpc_alert` entity from caiosweet's [DPC Alert](https://github.com/caiosweet/Home-Assistant-custom-components-DPC-Alert) integration, if installed, to add official Civil Protection bulletins as an alert source. Leave blank if you don't have that integration.

box_parse_error.title: iLMeteo.it: data could not be refreshed for {place_name}
box_parse_error.description: The integration can no longer parse the '{box_type}' data from iLMeteo.it for {place_name} — iLMeteo likely changed the page layout. The data shown may be stale until this is resolved. Check whether an integration update is available, or report the issue.
